[[Gunnery Sergeant]] '''Shorzen''' was an [[Imperial soldier]] stationed aboard the [[Gauntlet (Sith Empire)|''Gauntlet'']]. During the [[Battle of the Gauntlet]] he engaged [[Havoc Squad]] in combat, but was defeated and killed.
